scope: Episode 01 visible runtime props first, then Section 0 Field Guide items
governing_rule: No image generation or final promotion before Korean-site product/assembly verification.

sources.title: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제11조 작업장의 출입구
산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제21조 통로의 조명

site_gate.verified: Current Korean apartment construction examples repeatedly show a full-height temporary hoarding wall with a wide vehicle gate and a separate adjacent worker/pedestrian entrance or safety passage. The exact portal, booth and access-control hardware are site-specific.
site_gate.legal_basis: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제11조: when the primary entrance is for loading/transport machinery, a separate adjacent pedestrian entrance is required.

selected_episode01_visual_family.vehicle_gate: wide rectangular opening in temporary steel-panel hoarding, sized for dump/pump/truck entry
selected_episode01_visual_family.pedestrian_gate: separate narrow worker entrance immediately beside the vehicle gate
selected_episode01_visual_family.control: small guard/access-control booth or access-control post beside pedestrian entrance
selected_episode01_visual_family.separation: physical fence/rail or curb/line treatment keeps worker entry distinct from vehicle throat
selected_episode01_visual_family.signage: NEW PSI / fictional site only; no real constructor logos
selected_episode01_visual_family.road_context: construction access road with cones/bollards only where useful; no decorative clutter

render_contract.composition: one transparent cutout assembly showing vehicle portal + adjacent worker gate + small access-control booth
render_contract.materials: gray/white temporary steel hoarding panels and dark steel portal frame
render_contract.pedestrian_entry: clearly narrower and physically separate from vehicle opening
render_contract.worker_access: walkable threshold, no turnstile unless specifically authored later
render_contract.branding: NEW PSI or NEW PSI CONSTRUCTION only, otherwise blank
render_contract.text: no dense baked instructional text; a small GATE 1 / NEW PSI mark is optional
render_contract.camera: slight three-quarter front, readable vehicle and pedestrian openings simultaneously
render_contract.condition: active Korean apartment construction site, mildly weathered, not showroom-clean

reject: single vehicle opening with workers forced through the same throat
foreign stadium turnstile as the main visual
decorative security gate unrelated to construction hoarding
evidence: Korean current-site photos show large vehicle portals integrated into temporary hoarding and adjacent worker safety entrances/access-control rooms.
Ministry legal interpretation confirms the pedestrian entrance requirement is based on the primary use of the loading/transport entrance, not merely its size.

accepted: wide vehicle portal integrated with temporary hoarding
physical separation between worker and vehicle entries
limitations: finish is cleaner and more architectural than many active apartment sites; runtime grade should reduce showroom-like neatness
turnstile/access hardware remains site-specific and must not be treated as a universal Korean requirement

story_basis: Episode 01 identifies Kang Taesik as the formwork foreman.
When workers are diverted to clear the passage, the authored result explicitly says formwork cleanup slows.
Therefore the reusable Episode 01 material stack should visually read as formwork material cleanup, not as an arbitrary rebar pile.

selected_visual_family.panel_family: Korean Euroform steel-frame plywood panels, same size within one bundle
selected_visual_family.typical_reference_size: 600×1200 mm class used as the visual family reference; do not bake dimensions into the image
selected_visual_family.stack_method: horizontal same-spec stack on timber dunnage/sleepers
selected_visual_family.securing: two band/ratchet straps or equivalent visible securing consistent with a tidy site bundle
selected_visual_family.condition: used panels with realistic concrete residue and worn orange/brown/yellow steel frames; not factory-new

material_stack.official_basis: KOSHA reinforced-concrete/formwork guidance lists plywood, timber, Euroform and shoring materials as incoming formwork materials and requires stable storage so materials do not collapse; dismantled formwork materials should be orderly and balanced.

render_contract.object: one compact bundle of same-size used Korean Euroform 6012 panels
render_contract.panel_geometry: 600×1200 class, F-type perimeter/profile, cross-bars dividing the 1200 mm length into four approximately 300 mm bays, standardized side wedge-pin/tie holes
render_contract.orientation: horizontal stack with panel backs/edges readable
render_contract.support: two timber sleepers/dunnage under the bundle
render_contract.securing: two plain steel/PP bands; no large ratchet buckles
render_contract.face: dark coated plywood with realistic wear and light concrete residue
render_contract.frame: yellow/orange steel frame, used but structurally intact

reject: mixed rebar, pipe, lumber and formwork in one decorative pile
different panel sizes mixed in a single bundle
unrestrained leaning panels presented as the normal reference
generic lumber stack that does not read as Korean Euroform

accepted: four-bay cross-bar rhythm consistent with 1200 mm-class panel geometry
simple two-band securing with no oversized ratchet hardware
limitations: side wedge-pin/tie-hole geometry still requires close comparison before final binary registration
candidate is product-family accurate, not an exact manufacturer clone

access_barrier.verified: For Episode 01 use a Korean construction-site movable safety fence family rather than a generic foreign crowd-control barrier.

geometry_lock.base: two black weighted rubber/polymer bases, one near each vertical leg
geometry_lock.visibility_marking: short black-yellow hazard bands on top/bottom rail may be present by product variant
geometry_lock.center_print: omit from reusable game asset even when commercial products print 안전제일

render_contract.frame: silver galvanized round tube, continuous rounded top corners, approximately 25.4–31.8 mm product family
render_contract.feet: two black weighted bases; no fabricated steel A-frame feet
render_contract.infill: plain blue mesh/screen, taut but slightly field-worn
render_contract.condition: real Korean construction-site wear, no severe damage

reject: US/EU pedestrian crowd-control steel barricade with arched feet
water-filled road barrier as the default access fence
readable 안전제일 text baked into reusable runtime art

limitations: grommet/tie details treated as product-family approximation rather than an exact manufacturer copy
final approval still requires transparent WebP, checksum registration and in-game scale review

vehicle_overlap_zone.verified: This is a conflict relationship between vehicle and pedestrian routes, not a standalone piece of equipment.
vehicle_overlap_zone.render_contract: Render as map/scene overlay geometry only; do not image-generate a fictional physical object.
vehicle_overlap_zone.official_basis: KOSHA guidance requires separating construction-equipment routes from worker passages or controlling access/using a signal person where collision risk exists.

exclusion_zone.verified: Exclusion is created by barriers/cones/tape/signage and work control appropriate to the task.
exclusion_zone.render_contract: Compose from verified Korean barrier/cone assets in the scene; no standalone magical exclusion-zone prop.

open_edge.verified: A slab/platform edge or opening requires guardrail/fence/net/cover protection depending on the condition.
open_edge.render_contract: Use a real RC slab-edge scene fragment. Do not render an abstract 'open edge' object.

wet_floor.verified: Wet/slippery condition is a ground state and housekeeping hazard.
wet_floor.render_contract: Use wet concrete/soil surface decal or scene variation, not an isolated 3D item.

harness_unclipped.verified: Use a KCs-certified full-body harness family. Episode 01 may use a twin-Y double-lanyard configuration, but that configuration is not asserted as a universal Korean legal requirement.
harness_unclipped.render_contract: Brand-neutral Korean KCs-style full-body harness; correct D-ring, lanyards/hooks and shock-absorbing component where the selected certified product has them.

vehicle_pedestrian_separation.classification: separation system / site layout, not one universal product
vehicle_pedestrian_separation.verified: Korean safety rules require safe worker passages, and where the primary entrance is for material-handling equipment an adjacent pedestrian entrance is required. KOSHA guidance calls for worker passage separated from equipment travel routes.
vehicle_pedestrian_separation.render_contract: Use a real Korean site combination such as separated pedestrian lane + PE barrier/fence + lane markings; exact barrier family must be locked from a Korean product/site reference before final art.

temporary_distribution_board.classification: Korean FRP temporary construction distribution board

selected_product_family.enclosure: orange/yellow rectangular FRP cabinet with shallow rain lip/roof
selected_product_family.stand: simple black steel two-leg H-frame stand with flat feet
selected_product_family.indicator: single small red energized indicator on front
selected_product_family.outlets: blue weather-protected industrial outlets mounted on enclosure side; count kept modest
selected_product_family.door: plain closed front door with simple latch/lock provision
selected_product_family.handle: small side handle may be present
selected_product_family.grounding: grounding conductor/terminal may be represented if visually grounded in the selected product family

visual_evidence: Current Korean product listings show orange/yellow FRP temporary boards on simple black steel stands.
Multiple products show blue protected outlets on the sides and a small red energized indicator on the front.
An open-door reference confirms the same enclosure family contains breaker/RCD assemblies internally, but the normal reusable game asset remains closed.

render_contract.enclosure: simple orange/yellow FRP box; no lifting eyes; no heavy molded industrial roof
render_contract.stand: black square-tube two-leg H-stand, no A-frame bracing
render_contract.outlets: 2–4 blue weatherproof side outlets, Korean-market visual family
render_contract.lock: simple latch/lock provision, not an oversized padlock hero detail
render_contract.text: none; no fake warning labels or pseudo-Korean
render_contract.camera: slight front-left or front-right three-quarter view so one outlet side is visible
render_contract.wear: used site condition with light dust/scuffs, not rust-heavy

reject: red large IEC outlet as dominant feature
open breakers/live parts in the normal reference asset

hard_stop: If a visual family is still site-specific/unresolved, request or search a Korean reference before calling image generation.
